notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לבב em i 'bel bilong tingting' — Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim tingting na laik, wankain olsem Hibru.

notes.subject: וירעם / לרעות
notes.rationale: Stap.wantaim wasman long 70–71 i kamap gen long 72 — piksa bilong David olsem wasman i go het wantaim ol manmeri.

translation: Na em i lukautim ol olsem wasman wantaim bel i stret tru bilong em, na wantaim save bilong ol han bilong em em i soim rot long ol.
